gen-gf-baumans-gf-actor: Baumans hits hard, its crescent-wrench c opened wide and every stroke uniform. Actor takes over below, its sans-serif s curves wide and barely curled in, a quieter partner for the stout heading.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-graduate: Graduate is a serif with generous white between letters. Baumans is the one for punch, with uniform strokes and that wide crescent c, while Graduate keeps lowercase close to capital height for steady reading.
gen-gf-baumans-plus-jakarta-sans: Blunt, crescent-wrench energy up top, with Baumans stamping every stroke at a single thickness. Plus Jakarta Sans then carries the text in precise monoline strokes whose curve endings stay well apart, so paragraphs read smoothly.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-rowan: Rowan is literary and friendly, with generous openings in every curve. Bellota draws every line flat and unmodulated above, while Rowan below adds a mild swing between heavy and light strokes.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-cardo: Stripped-back and sturdy, Bellota Text gives its crossbars the full weight of its stems. Cardo is the quiet counterweight, with light modulation you notice only up close; that gap in line weight is the pairing's whole appeal.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-spectral: A wire-like line gives Bellota Text its odd, commanding presence. Bellota Text is best at open, unshaded letterforms, whereas Spectral does bookish text with stems slightly heavier than its crossbars.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-fs-rowan: A ruler-drawn, constant-width line defines Bruno Ace. Bruno Ace is best at lines that never swell or thin, while Rowan is best at literary, friendly warmth, with sturdy hairlines and open curves.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-actor: Bruno Ace is a thread of ink, never swelling or tapering. Actor, a modern sans-serif whose s curves run wide, carries that restraint into the text, and that shared plainness is the pair's real draw.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-cardo: Expressive from the first letter, Bruno Ace lays down a ruler-drawn line with crossbars exactly matching its stems in thickness. Cardo's lightly modulated, dignified letters give that rigor somewhere gentle to land.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-chakra-petch: Distinctive in its slow, one-character-per-beat rhythm, Bruno Ace holds a constant-width line with counters that open outward. Chakra Petch is best at cupped, contemporary round letters, while Bruno Ace is best at setting a slow beat.
